parameters.query:
UPDATE deals 
SET conversation_history = $2::jsonb,
    last_interaction = $3,
    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE deal_id = $1

nodes.name: Update Conversation History
nodes.notes: PostgreSQL: Updates conversation history as JSONB for AI context.

parameters.query:
UPDATE deals 
SET status = 'needs_pricing_decision',
    escalation_timestamp = $2,
    escalation_reason = 'AI needs pricing guidance',
    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE deal_id = $1

nodes.name: Update Status - Pricing
nodes.notes: PostgreSQL: Escalates to owner for pricing decision. Status: needs_pricing_decision

parameters.query:
